title: Robust and Efficient Communication for Multi-Agent Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.15361v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Effective communication is a cornerstone of distributed intelligence in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), yet ensuring that generated messages are both informative and robust to physical constraints remains a significant challenge. This paper introduces Multi-Agent Regularized Communication (MARC), a novel framework inspired by information-theoretic principles of conditional mutual information. MARC employs an attention-based architecture coupled with a unique message regularization mechanism designed to minimize uncertainty regarding future system states, thereby inducing the learning of highly representative communication protocols. Crucially, we evaluate MARC under stringent communication bottlenecks and lossy channels, simulating the real-world constraints of autonomous robotic networks and decentralized systems. translated_title: 面向多智能体学习的鲁棒高效通信
translated_abstract: 有效通信是多智能体强化学习（MARL）中分布式智能的基石，然而确保生成的消息既信息丰富又对物理约束具有鲁棒性，仍然是一项重大挑战。本文提出了多智能体正则化通信（MARC），这是一个受条件互信息的信息论原理启发的新型框架。MARC采用基于注意力的架构，并结合一种独特的消息正则化机制，旨在最小化关于未来系统状态的不确定性，从而促使学习出高度代表性的通信协议。至关重要的是，我们在严格的通信瓶颈和有损信道条件下评估了MARC，以模拟自主机器人网络和去中心化系统的现实约束。我们的结果表明，MARC在复杂合作环境中显著优于最先进的方法。
tldr: 本文提出基于条件互信息的多智能体正则化通信框架MARC，通过注意力架构与消息正则化机制学习高度代表性的通信协议，在通信瓶颈和有损信道等严苛现实约束下显著优于现有最先进方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MARC, a novel multi-agent communication framework inspired by conditional mutual information, which leverages an attention-based architecture with message regularization to learn highly representative communication protocols, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art methods under stringent communication bottlenecks and lossy channels.
